join hortbot 999 foobar 1
twitch_get_user_by_username {"random": {"id": 2, "login": "random"}}

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :+p
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: +p <user>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :++p
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :-p
no_send

twitch_ban {"BroadcasterID": 1, "ModID": 999, "Tok": {"access_token": "some-access-token", "token_type": "bearer", "refresh_token": "some-refresh-token", "expiry": "2050-10-01T03:11:00Z"}, "Req": {"user_id": 2, "duration": 1, "reason": "Purging chat messages"}}
handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :+p random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random's chat history has been purged.

no_send

no_send
